applied.quote: It is held with a financial institution under IRA-style rules: the money is locked until January 1 of the year the child turns 18, and it can only hold an S&P 500 or U.S.-equity index fund.
applied.replacement: Under its rules, the money is locked until January 1 of the year the child turns 18, and it can only hold an S&P 500 or U.S.-equity index fund.
applied.why: Fact list never says it is held with a financial institution.

applied.quote: After 18 it works like a traditional IRA, with withdrawals taxed as ordinary income, while a taxable brokerage account is fully liquid and can hold any investment.
applied.replacement: After 18 it works like a traditional IRA, while a brokerage account is fully liquid and can hold any investment.
applied.why: Ordinary-income taxation and 'taxable' brokerage are not in the fact list.
